lines.q: Salem witches in sixteen ninety-two were executed by what?
lines.a: Hanging! Not a single one was burned at the stake.

lines.q: Vampire bats drink blood by doing what?
lines.a: Lapping it up! They lick it like a cat. No sucking.

lines.q: Ground-up mummies were once sold in Europe as what?
lines.a: Medicine! People actually ate powdered mummy.

lines.q: Last one. A group of owls is called a what?
lines.a: A parliament! A murder is crows.
